scoring_note: 独立采用分不使用 stars；由外部 issue/PR 作者、贡献者广度、近 100 个 PR 的合并数、forks 和 release 新鲜度组成。它是 GitHub 公开信号代理，不是科研影响力结论。
warning: Stars, forks and repository metadata were refreshed on the generated date. Independent-adoption scores retain their earlier observation date; newly discovered repositories remain a separate watchlist until the same issue/PR and dependency audit is completed.
